# jamfplatform_pro_mobile_device_invitation (Data Source)

Look up a Jamf Pro mobile device enrollment invitation by numeric `id` or by its Jamf Pro-generated `invitation` code (the admin UI "Invitation ID"). Exactly one of `id` or `invitation` must be supplied.

**Required Jamf privileges**

The Jamf Platform API integration used by the provider must be granted the following privileges:

| Required privilege |
|---|
| `enrollment-invitations:read` |

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a mobile device invitation by its numeric ID.
data "jamfplatform_pro_mobile_device_invitation" "example_by_id" {
  id = "42"
}

# Look up a mobile device invitation by its Jamf Pro-generated invitation code (the
# admin UI "Invitation ID"). Exactly one of id or invitation must be supplied.
data "jamfplatform_pro_mobile_device_invitation" "example_by_invitation" {
  invitation = "308000000000000000000000000000000000001"
}

output "mobile_device_invitation_example_by_id" {
  value = data.jamfplatform_pro_mobile_device_invitation.example_by_id
}

output "mobile_device_invitation_example_by_invitation" {
  value = data.jamfplatform_pro_mobile_device_invitation.example_by_invitation
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Numeric mobile device invitation ID. Mutually exclusive with `invitation`.
- `invitation` (String) Invitation code generated by Jamf Pro (the admin UI "Invitation ID"). Mutually exclusive with `id`.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `date_sent` (String) Date the invitation email was sent.
- `date_sent_epoch` (String) Date the invitation email was sent, as epoch milliseconds.
- `date_sent_utc` (String) Date the invitation email was sent, in UTC.
- `enroll_into_site_id` (String) Jamf Pro site ID the enrolled mobile device is assigned to (`-1` when none).
- `enroll_into_site_name` (String) Display name of the site the enrolled mobile device is assigned to (`NONE` when none).
- `expiration_date` (String) Invitation expiration (`Unlimited` or `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`).
- `expiration_date_epoch` (String) Expiration date as epoch milliseconds.
- `expiration_date_utc` (String) Expiration date in UTC.
- `invitation_type` (String) Invitation delivery type.
- `keep_existing_site_membership` (Boolean) Whether an enrolling mobile device keeps its existing site membership.
- `last_action` (String) Last action recorded for the invitation.
- `message` (String) Body of the enrollment email.
- `multiple_uses_allowed` (Boolean) Whether the invitation may be used for more than one mobile device.
- `reply_to` (String) Reply-to address for the enrollment email.
- `require_login` (Boolean) Whether the enrolling user must authenticate (the admin UI "Require Login").
- `sent_from` (String) From address for the enrollment email.
- `sent_to` (String) Recipient address for the enrollment email.
- `subject` (String) Subject line of the enrollment email.
- `target_ios` (String) Target iOS version for the invitation.
- `username` (String) Username associated with the invitation.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
